limitations: The fixed board-conditioned student failed its registered real KataGo strength criterion. No new training or strong-play claim.
Both players use the same own policy. Actual self-play random draws are available only in the explicitly marked known-policy joint controls.
Place-only device proposals omit captures, suicide and superko. Native root checks are atomic; each consumed own-policy row must have a matched action prefix and exact current board input.
Behavior predictions optimize observed-action likelihood and do not supply MCTS priors or opponent-optimal labels.
CPU execution, serial native batch resolver, full history prefill at each dispatch; the timings are instrumented diagnostics with unequal work.
Per-mode runs overlap game histories and greedy game IDs may be identical. No independent-game uncertainty estimate, sample-efficiency gain or MFU claim.

mechanism_criterion.scope: Both thresholds must hold in both sampling conditions alongside exact prefix equivalence. This is a feasibility screen for later matched-work TPU experiments; it does not promote the failed-strength student.

covers: Fresh-prefix logits for every reported policy row
Actual own-policy RNG invariance across packet boundaries

primary: All five multi-ply conditions must reproduce the one-ply sequential action/event prefix exactly in both greedy and stochastic execution, including game resets and terminal scores. Any action change or mismatched consumed board input fails qualification. No MCTS decisions are made.
